scope.summary: Reoriented the browser operator dashboard around governed Oracle workflows, removed all routed repository-development surfaces and the Orrery implementation/dependencies/wiring, repaired pairing visibility and recovery, and tightened browser action gates and UI truthfulness.
out_of_scope: maintainer-only CI-lane API support for external library embedders

entry_points.name: oraclemcp dashboard pairing form and one-time handshake
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-core dashboard_pairing: 6 passed; pairing form tests cover secure cookies, query-secret refusal, null-Origin refusal, and one-time code handling.

entry_points.name: served dashboard end-user routes and browser Workbench release gate
entry_points.trace: cd web && npm run check passed TypeScript, production build/SBOM/bundle checks, and 160 tests; npm run test:e2e passed 3 shipped-dashboard browser flows with 2 explicitly live-server-gated skips.

entry_points.name: browser SQL action policy and change-proposal classification
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-core dashboard_workbench: 4 passed; status gate propagation tests passed; classifier/unit mismatch test passed.

entry_points.name: dashboard source-level acceptance contracts
entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp --test dashboard_e2e: 12 passed; dashboard skin lint, sensitive-data lint, cargo fmt check, and oraclemcp honesty grep passed.

limitations: No live Oracle service was used; this evidence is scoped to browser, source-contract, and focused Rust tests.
The two Playwright tests that require an explicitly configured live oraclemcp server were skipped; all three self-contained shipped-dashboard browser tests passed.

React Doctor improved from 48 to 74 with no errors and 40 remaining warnings; the two cache-invalidation warnings are on-demand read operations, while the remainder is legacy file-size/export/performance maintainability debt rather than a newly asserted green gate.

Repository Rule 1 forbids deleting a tracked file without an exact deletion command, so web/src/app/orrery-renderer.tsx remains as an inert three-line module; the renderer implementation, imports, dependencies, skin registry, and view-model wiring are absent and lint-gated.
